requirements.rule: Art. 71: the allowance absorbs the individual superminimo 'fino a concorrenza del 50% di tale importo' (at most 25,83). The engine pays it whole: its absorption (absorbed_by_individual_excess) offsets the whole allowance, not half of it.
requirements.remediation: Absorb the individual superminimo into the art. 71 allowance up to half of its amount.

requirements.rule: INPS RATES: the employer and worker INPS rates of the sector (artigianato) are totals no 2026 INPS or association table confirms: the only component split found is the INPS guide of 2012 and the 2026 totals come from a software house page that does not prove its year. The contributions of every run rest on them.
requirements.remediation: Source the artigianato rates of 2026 on an INPS or association table, mark the inps block of contribution/2026/artigianato.json derived, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: LEVEL CATEGORY: all levels left null. Multiple levels map to both operai and impiegati roles — a genuine one-to-many mapping the schema cannot represent as a single category value.
requirements.remediation: Declare the worker category in the request; the levels map to both operai and impiegati.

requirements.rule: Only aziende artigiane salary tables modelled. PMI non-artigiane tables (Art. 4, with EUR 207 total increase vs EUR 200 for artigiane, difference of EUR 7 in the Nov 2026 tranche) are not modelled. Applies to a small minority of firms covered by this CCNL.
requirements.remediation: Add the Art. 4 PMI non-artigiane salary tables and a request field to select them.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid as a private one (art. 5 names the "Stato, enti pubblici e datori privati").
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.
